description: Estonian company by register code (registrikood, 10137319) or name, from the Estonian e-Business Register: name, former names, legal form, status (registered, in liquidation, in bankruptcy), registered address and a link to the register's page. Use to verify an Estonian customer or supplier. Register facts only, not a credit report. Example: regCode=10137319. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

limit.description: Matches for a name search (1-10, default 5)

name.description: Company name to search for, instead of regCode: up to 10 current companies whose name holds every word

regCode.description: Estonian register code (registrikood, 8 digits) (give regCode or name)
